verdict.rationale: Paddle's own docs cover recurring subscriptions sold through checkout, multi-tier plans, and upgrades or downgrades by replacing items or changing billing frequency. Paddle also creates transactions automatically for subscription lifecycle events. However, the pack never mentions free trials and never explicitly describes proration behavior. Missing for 10: documented trial periods, explicit proration handling on plan changes, independent hands-on corroboration.
